guidance.statement: Management remains confident of delivering EBITDA margins within the established corridor for the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: we remain very confident of Q3 and quite confident of the full second half that we should be able to deliver in our EBITDA margin corridor of 20% to 24%

guidance.statement: The company aims to maintain double-digit underlying volume growth despite macroeconomic challenges and inflationary pressures.
guidance.quote: we stay firmly focused on trying delivering double-digit underlying volume growth even under these trying circumstances.

guidance.statement: Management desires to gradually increase underlying volume growth from current levels to early teens over time.
guidance.quote: we want to take this from classic double digit to early teens. I think that's the desire over a period of time.

guidance.statement: The company expects its volume growth to continue outperforming the national GDP growth rate.
guidance.quote: If the country's growth is in the 6.5, 7 range in real terms, our UVG growth should remain double digit

achieved.claim: Delivered 11% underlying volume growth for the first half of the fiscal year.
International subsidiaries grew revenue by 21.8% with EBITDA growth of 53%.
Domestic subsidiaries delivered strong revenue growth of 22.2% led by Consumer and Bazaar.
Maintained double-digit underlying volume growth for approximately 6 to 8 consecutive quarters.

pushback.concern: Analysts questioned the delay in pricing actions despite significantly elevated VAM and crude-linked input costs.
Impact of 12-15% price hikes on future demand sustainability given macroeconomic uncertainty.
Whether the company will set up its own VAM plant to mitigate supply chain volatility.

output.tone_why: Management balances strong volume performance against significant raw material volatility and geopolitical uncertainty.
